_doc: Runtime evidence grade per runtime_h row, first matching rule wins. A: Notebookcheck WLAN at ~150 cd/m2 (stated since the Aug 2012 reviews). B: another third-party browsing test at a stated calibrated brightness. C: a third-party browsing test without one. claimed_runtime_h rows are always D.

rules._why: The review states its WLAN test ran at about 150 cd/m2 (2012 MacBook Air reviews state it in July, before the date cutoff).

pick._doc: Which of several same-grade results displays. Laptops were reviewed in several display/CPU configs that move runtime by up to 2x, and a median of an OLED and an IPS config describes no real machine, so laptops show the longest-running tested config; the popover lists the others.
